descriptions.BASIC: Reduces the movement penalty of rough terrain by 25.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Reduces the movement penalty of rough terrain by 50.
descriptions.EXPERT: Reduces the movement penalty of rough terrain by 75.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the damage of the hero's shooters by 10%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the damage of the hero's shooters by 25%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the damage of the hero's shooters by 50%.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the hero's movement on land by 10%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the hero's movement on land by 20%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the hero's movement on land by 30%.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the hero's sight radius by 1.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the hero's sight radius by 2.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the hero's sight radius by 3.

descriptions.BASIC: Some wandering monsters offer to join the hero, and surrendering costs 20% less.
descriptions.ADVANCED: More wandering monsters offer to join the hero, and surrendering costs 40% less.
descriptions.EXPERT: Many wandering monsters offer to join the hero, and surrendering costs 60% less.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the hero's movement at sea by 50%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the hero's movement at sea by 100%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the hero's movement at sea by 150%.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the morale of the hero's troops by 1.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the morale of the hero's troops by 2.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the morale of the hero's troops by 3.

descriptions.BASIC: Lets the hero learn spells of the third level.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Lets the hero learn spells of the fourth level.
descriptions.EXPERT: Lets the hero learn spells of every level.

descriptions.BASIC: The hero regains 2 more spell points each day.
descriptions.ADVANCED: The hero regains 3 more spell points each day.
descriptions.EXPERT: The hero regains 4 more spell points each day.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the luck of the hero's troops by 1.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the luck of the hero's troops by 2.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the luck of the hero's troops by 3.

descriptions.BASIC: Gives control of the catapult in sieges and makes its shots more accurate.
descriptions.ADVANCED: The catapult shoots twice a round and hits harder.
descriptions.EXPERT: The catapult shoots twice a round, hits harder still and rarely misses.

descriptions.BASIC: Gives a 40% chance to learn a spell of up to the second level cast in battle.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Gives a 50% chance to learn a spell of up to the third level cast in battle.
descriptions.EXPERT: Gives a 60% chance to learn a spell of up to the fourth level cast in battle.

descriptions.BASIC: Raises 10% of the enemy creatures killed in battle as Skeletons.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Raises 20% of the enemy creatures killed in battle as Skeletons.
descriptions.EXPERT: Raises 30% of the enemy creatures killed in battle as Skeletons.

descriptions.BASIC: Brings the kingdom 125 gold a day.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Brings the kingdom 250 gold a day.
descriptions.EXPERT: Brings the kingdom 500 gold a day.

descriptions.BASIC: Fire spells cost less and work better.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Fire spells cost less and work much better.
descriptions.EXPERT: Fire spells cost less and work at their full strength.

descriptions.BASIC: Air spells cost less and work better.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Air spells cost less and work much better.
descriptions.EXPERT: Air spells cost less and work at their full strength.

descriptions.BASIC: Water spells cost less and work better.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Water spells cost less and work much better.
descriptions.EXPERT: Water spells cost less and work at their full strength.

descriptions.BASIC: Earth spells cost less and work better.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Earth spells cost less and work much better.
descriptions.EXPERT: Earth spells cost less and work at their full strength.

descriptions.BASIC: Heroes who meet teach each other spells of up to the second level.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Heroes who meet teach each other spells of up to the third level.
descriptions.EXPERT: Heroes who meet teach each other spells of up to the fourth level.

descriptions.BASIC: Lets the hero place their troops up to 3 columns forward before a battle.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Lets the hero place their troops up to 5 columns forward before a battle.
descriptions.EXPERT: Lets the hero place their troops up to 7 columns forward before a battle.

descriptions.BASIC: Gives control of the Ballista, with a 50% chance of double damage.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Gives control of the Ballista, with a 75% chance of double damage.
descriptions.EXPERT: Gives control of the Ballista, which always does double damage.

descriptions.BASIC: The hero earns 5% more experience.
descriptions.ADVANCED: The hero earns 10% more experience.
descriptions.EXPERT: The hero earns 15% more experience.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the melee damage of the hero's troops by 10%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the melee damage of the hero's troops by 20%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the melee damage of the hero's troops by 30%.

descriptions.BASIC: Reduces the damage the hero's troops take by 5%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Reduces the damage the hero's troops take by 10%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Reduces the damage the hero's troops take by 15%.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the hero's spell points by 25%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the hero's spell points by 50%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the hero's spell points by 100%.

descriptions.BASIC: Increases the damage of the hero's spells by 5%.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Increases the damage of the hero's spells by 10%.
descriptions.EXPERT: Increases the damage of the hero's spells by 15%.

descriptions.BASIC: Gives the hero's troops a 5% chance to resist an enemy spell.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Gives the hero's troops a 10% chance to resist an enemy spell.
descriptions.EXPERT: Gives the hero's troops a 20% chance to resist an enemy spell.

descriptions.BASIC: Gives control of the First Aid Tent, which heals up to 50 health.
descriptions.ADVANCED: Gives control of the First Aid Tent, which heals up to 75 health.
descriptions.EXPERT: Gives control of the First Aid Tent, which heals up to 100 health.
